candidate.method: Zero-shot two-way action/outcome matching from bounded visible-state and semantic outcome-diff summaries. Each case is scored in both candidate orders; first-token A/B log-odds are differenced to reduce position bias.

finding: The candidate did not beat the 7/14 balanced-label chance baseline overall. The tiny non-navigation slice is uninterpretable. The earlier unmirrored pass chose A for every case, showing a strong position bias.
limitations: Exact visible state does not prove equal hidden browser or server state; these are observational branches, not controlled counterfactuals.
The public test set was evaluation-only and was not used for fitting or calibration.
The deterministic eligibility filter leaves mostly direct navigation, not a representative browser or desktop task sample.
Semantic outcome summaries are truncated and do not test full next-state generation or multi-step success.
This does not measure Heliox runtime performance, safety, autonomy, or Jev parity. No weights are promoted.
